title: Tencent says it plans to spend significantly more on AI infrastructure in H2 2026 as more China-designed AI chips become available "month by month" (The Information)
summary: The Information: Tencent says it plans to spend significantly more on AI infrastructure in H2 2026 as more China-designed AI chips become available “month by month” — Tencent Holdings is gearing up to spend more on AI infrastructure after chip shortages began showing signs of relief.
